verdict.rationale: Data region or residency selection is a fair question for a SaaS feedback platform like Canny, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions choosing a storage region, EU/US hosting, or residency controls. The staging workspace is a separate instance for testing, not a residency option, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
